requirements.quote: Storybook stories with interaction tests for every enquiry component and state (default, empty, loading, error, offline, denied) under packages/ui/src/patterns/enquiry or the route _components, with unique story export names across apps/web.
Playwright specs under e2e/tests/people: flag-on flow, flag-off 404 (enquiry-gated-off), keyboard-only, axe zero serious/critical on every state
requirements.evidence: e2e workflow (Playwright, ship PRs and nightly); axe runs in the @a11y fixture
e2e workflow update_snapshots dispatch generates baselines; spec skips without one (people.visual.spec.ts:24)

deliverables.change: Stories (names prefixed EnquiryList*): default, empty, offline (forceOffline), keyboard shortcuts n/c/Cmd+Enter, Tamil and Kannada names; mock actions with fn<>; play interaction tests. Loading/denied/error states: add stories rendering the route's loading.tsx skeleton and PermissionDeniedPage/error UI where they are client-renderable (EnquiryListLoading/Denied/Error) in this file or a sibling states story.
EnquiryForm* stories: open, offline, validation error, action failure; unique names.
ConflictPanel* stories: not run, running, no hits, hits with warning text 'Possible conflict. Review before you proceed.', error, disabled/offline, decision note proceed/decline/refer; Tamil/Kannada.
OutcomeDialog* stories: open, offline, error; unique names.

Guard test modelled on apps/web/__tests__/people-stories.test.ts: each enquiries/_components component that is storybook-able has sibling stories with default meta; Tamil/Kannada stories for name components; story export names unique across all apps/web *.stories.tsx files (static scan of `export const X:`). gated-notice.tsx (async server component) is listed as an explicit exclusion with reason.

Helpers: enable legal-gated intake.enquiry_log for the fixture workspace (SQL into feature_flag + workspace_feature_flag with legal ack, per whatsapp-import-helpers.ts:17-43), seed/empty enquiry rows (see packages/db/src/schema/enquiry.ts), openEnquiries, volatile mask.

Flag-on flow (log enquiry, run conflict check, see conflict warning, decide, close with outcome), flag-off 404 test named 'enquiry-gated-off' (route returns 404, nav entry hidden), non-owner/advocate denied, keyboard-only (n, c, Cmd/Ctrl+Enter), empty/loading/error/offline states via ?__state, and a route check that nothing public creates an enquiry only if cheap (already covered in #874 route-inventory test).
@a11y tests following people.a11y.spec.ts, each ending on one state: list, empty, form dialog, conflict panel with hits, outcome dialog, loading, error, offline, denied, gated-off 404.

Visual baselines following people.visual.spec.ts (skipWithoutBaseline; project matrix gives light/dark x 360/768/1280): list, empty, form, conflict panel, outcome dialog, error, denied. Do not commit snapshot images.

preserve.what: Production enquiry UI, actions and flag gating unchanged: apps/web/app/(app)/w/[slug]/people/enquiries/** non-story files, apps/web/lib/intake/intake-deps.ts, apps/web/lib/nav.ts
